findings.highlight: I'm just a homunculus made to look human.
findings.evidenceJa: そういう風に作られたホムンクルス
findings.governingReading: そういう風に作られた explains her being a Grail homunculus rather than originally human.
findings.explanation: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.

findings.highlight: Born from less than respectable methods
findings.evidenceJa: まっとうな手段によって生まれ得なかった
findings.governingReading: まっとうな手段 contrasts normal birth with artificial magical creation.

findings.highlight: Some other force stronger than me pulled them away.
findings.evidenceJa: 引き寄せる力はそっちの方が強くなってた
findings.governingReading: By the time she noticed Caster/Lancer were taken and the other attraction had become greater, explaining subsequent majority capture.
findings.explanation: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.

findings.highlight: The container can't hold all of them.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯”自体の魂の入る余地なんてない
findings.governingReading: 聖杯自体の魂 is the vessel’s own personality/soul, excluded by containing seven; next20 explains personality erasure.
findings.explanation: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.

findings.highlight: I said that I'm beyond saving, just like Sakura, you know.
findings.evidenceJa: わたし、サクラはもう助からないって言ったのよ
findings.governingReading: わたし marks the speaker of said; its content is Sakura cannot be saved.
findings.explanation: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.

findings.highlight: I never made her any promises, nor did she ask for anything.
findings.evidenceJa: 何も約束なんて出来ないし、何がほしかったワケでもない
findings.governingReading: Both clauses continue Shirou: no promise he can make, no desired thing prompting the hug.
findings.explanation: Cannot promise and wanted nothing become no prior promises and Illya asking nothing.
